headline: Vivo X500 Pro Max achieves 17 stops of dynamic range and 4K240 slo-mo
summary: The new Vivo X500 Pro Max boasts an impressive 17 stops of dynamic range and can capture video at a staggering 4K resolution and 240 frames per second.
details: Vivo has unveiled its latest flagship smartphone, the X500 Pro Max, pushing the boundaries of mobile photography and videography. The device features a camera system co-engineered with ZEISS, promising professional-grade imaging capabilities.

A standout feature is the camera's 17 stops of dynamic range, allowing for incredible detail in both the brightest highlights and darkest shadows of a scene. This capability is crucial for capturing challenging lighting conditions with remarkable fidelity.

Videographers will appreciate the X500 Pro Max's ability to shoot in 4K resolution at an astonishing 240 frames per second. This high frame rate enables ultra-slow-motion footage, opening up new creative possibilities for capturing fast-paced action or subtle movements.

The phone also includes a "ZEISS Telephoto Extender Gen 2 Ultra," offering an equivalent focal length of 400mm. This accessory, when used with the phone, allows for extreme telephoto shots, bringing distant subjects closer with impressive clarity.

Powered by OriginOS 7, the Vivo X500 Pro Max aims to deliver a seamless and intuitive user experience, complementing its advanced camera hardware with intelligent software features. The device is positioned to compete at the high end of the smartphone market.
